summary: Rate Service feature validated end-to-end. Backend 6/6 pytest cases pass covering GET /bookings/my/pending-reviews shape+sort, auto_prompt=true after reset, POST /{id}/review-prompt-dismiss silences ALL (count unchanged, auto_prompt all false), POST /{id}/review removes item from pending and silences the rest, auth/role gating, double-submit rejection. Frontend web (web_panel) 14/14 UI assertions pass on mobile 390x844 and desktop 1920x900: auto popup appears on '/' for latest unrated (Plumbing Repair) with auto_prompt=true, 'Not now' closes and no chain popup appears, rate-service-bar visible right-side above bottom nav, bar visible on '/' and /account (home) but hidden on /services, /account?tab=orders and /book. Submitting a rating closes modal, no new auto popup opens, bar remains with next unrated service. Desktop bar (x=1568) does not overlap custom-job-fab (x=1840). Logged-out users see neither bar nor popup.
critical_code_review_comments: RateService.jsx line 44: useEffect returns subscribe?.(cb) directly — if subscribe() does not return an unsubscribe function this becomes a no-op cleanup; low risk because RealtimeContext.subscribe returns an unsubscribe, but worth asserting.

pending_reviews controller: review_prompt_dismissed is reset by _silence_review_prompts globally for all completed bookings of the customer; this is consistent with spec ('older ones don't chain-pop') but means a brand-new completion will NOT auto-pop if a previous one was ever dismissed until the backend explicitly clears the flag on that new booking. Confirm this is intentional for the 'partner completes a job -> auto popup opens' requirement — new completions coming in with status completed will have review_prompt_dismissed unset so auto_prompt will be true, so this is actually fine.
pending_reviews uses to_list(500) — if a prolific customer has >500 completed-unrated bookings they would be silently truncated; add a hard cap or ordering in Mongo query.
seed_data_creation: Reseeded via /app/backend/seed_rate_service_demo.py (AZORATE1-3) and unset review_prompt_dismissed on customer c336c969-da1e-4d46-aaad-9bcdb875bb15 bookings before UI run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints: GET /api/bookings/my/pending-reviews, POST /api/bookings/{id}/review-prompt-dismiss, POST /api/bookings/{id}/review. Note _silence_review_prompts sets review_prompt_dismissed=true for ALL customer's completed/paid bookings on both submit and dismiss. To re-run UI tests, reseed and `db.bookings.updateMany({customer_id:'c336c969-...'}, {$unset:{review_prompt_dismissed:''}})` to re-enable auto popup. Expo Customer/src/components/customer/RateService.tsx was not executed (Expo cannot run in this env) — code review only was in scope.
rca of the issue: No issue. All assertions matched the spec.
